title: Software Developer
teaser: Nous recherchons un Développeur Logiciel passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe d'infrastructure Nexus Dashboard. Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler sur des technologies de pointe, en optimisant la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes de gestion de données. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'automatisation des centres de données.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/24/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

Cisco Nexus Dashboard is the unified operations platform designed to simplify and accelerate data center management. Built on a robust, Kubernetes-based microservices architecture, it serves as a single pane of glass for the Cisco data center portfolio, including ACI and Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC). By integrating sophisticated telemetry, orchestration, and policy management services, the platform empowers organizations to streamline their operational workflows, enhance visibility, and ensure consistent configuration and security across diverse physical and virtual environments.

The Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team serves as the backbone of our platform, engineering the critical services that ensure stability, security, and seamless lifecycle management for our global data center customers. By managing the core Kubernetes-based architecture, our team provides the crucial foundation upon which advanced orchestration, telemetry, and policy services are built and scaled. We are a fast-paced, dynamic group of engineers who thrive on collaboration and constant innovation, working closely with cross-functional teams to solve complex infrastructure challenges in real-time. We cultivate a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence, making this the ideal environment for engineers who are passionate about building robust, high-scale infrastructure.

Your Impact

Joining Nexus Dashboard infrastructure team means operating at the groundbreaking of platform technologies, where you will have the opportunity to directly influence the future of data center automation and platform reliability.

Core Platform Engineering: Architect and maintain the core infrastructure of the Nexus Dashboard, a Kubernetes-based platform, ensuring high availability and performance across its integrated data stack, including PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Kafka.

Cluster Lifecycle Management: Oversee the full deployment lifecycle of multi-node clusters, including automated installation, configuration, and seamless inline software upgrades across diverse physical and virtual form factors.

System Reliability & Observability: Develop and support critical infrastructure services, including robust backup and restore frameworks, automated anomaly detection, and comprehensive audit logging to ensure platform reliability and operational transparency.

Security & Identity Infrastructure: Implement and manage enterprise-grade security protocols, focusing on centralized Authentication and Authorization (AAA) and end-to-end certificate lifecycle management for both cluster-level and microservice-level communications.

Scalability & Performance Optimization: Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimize platform scalability and resource efficiency, ensuring the Nexus Dashboard remains a resilient and performant foundation for data center telemetry and orchestration services.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelors +7 years related experience or Masters +4 years of related experience.

Experience programming in languages such as Go and Python, including leveraging AI-assisted development tools to write, test, and optimize code.

Experience with rapid prototyping of AI solutions and AI workflow/agent engineering.

Experience in developing, deploying, and managing microservices on Kubernetes-based orchestration platforms.

Experience designing and implementing robust test plans to ensure software quality, reliability, and coverage across all use cases.

Preferred Qualifications

Proficiency in Linux system internals, including process management, file systems, and networking.

Understanding of distributed databases and messaging systems, such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Kafka.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines.

Rencontrez l’équipe

Cisco Nexus Dashboard est la plateforme d’opérations unifiées conçue pour simplifier et accélérer la gestion du centre de données. Fondé sur une architecture de microservices robuste basée sur Kubernetes, il sert d'interface unique pour la gamme de centres de données de Cisco, y compris ACI et Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC). En intégrant des services sophistiqués de télémétrie, d’orchestration et de gestion des politiques, la plateforme permet aux entreprises de simplifier leurs flux de travail opérationnels, d’améliorer la visibilité et d’assurer une configuration et une sécurité cohérentes dans divers environnements physiques et virtuels.

L’équipe d'infrastructure Nexus Dashboard est le réseau fédérateur de notre plateforme, concevant les services essentiels qui assurent la stabilité, la sécurité et une gestion transparente du cycle de vie pour nos clients de centre de données mondiaux. En gérant l’architecture de base basée sur Kubernetes, notre équipe fournit la base cruciale sur laquelle l’orchestration avancée, la télémétrie et les services de politiques sont conçus et évoluent. Nous sommes un groupe d’ingénieurs percutants et dynamiques qui s’épanouissent dans la collaboration et l’innovation constante et qui travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour résoudre des problèmes infrastructure complexes en temps réel. Nous cultivons une culture de l’apprentissage continu et de l’excellence technique, ce qui en fait un environnement idéal pour les ingénieurs passionnés par la construction d'infrastructures robustes et à grande échelle.

Votre impact

Se joindre à l’équipe infrastructure de Nexus Dashboard, c’est être à la pointe des technologies de plateforme, où vous aurez l’occasion d’influencer directement l’avenir de l'automatisation des centres de données et de la fiabilité des plateformes.
•    Ingénierie de la plateforme de base : concevoir et maintenir l’ infrastructure de base du tableau de bord Nexus , une plateforme basée sur Kubernetes, en veillant à ce que la pile de données intégrée, y compris PostgreSQL, OpenSearch et Kafka, dispose d’une disponibilité et d’un rendement élevés.
•    Gestion du cycle de vie des clusters : superviser le cycle de vie complet du déploiement des clusters multinœuds, y compris l’installation automatisée, la configuration et les mises à niveau logicielles en ligne transparentes dans divers facteurs de forme physiques et virtuels.
•    Fiabilité et observabilité du système : développer et soutenir des services d'infrastructure essentiels, y compris des cadres de sauvegarde et de restauration robustes , la détection automatisée des anomalies et des journaux d’audit complets pour assurer la fiabilité de la plateforme et la transparence opérationnelle.
•    Infrastructure de sécurité et d’identité : Implémenter et gérer des protocoles de sécurité de niveau entreprise, en se concentrant sur l’authentification et l’autorisation (AAA ) centralisées et la gestion du cycle de vie des certificats de bout en bout pour les communications au niveau du cluster et du microservice.
•    Évolutivité et optimisation du rendement : collaborer avec des équipes d’ingénierie interfonctionnelles pour optimiser l'évolutivité de la plateforme et l’efficacité des ressources, en veillant à ce que le tableau de bord Nexus reste une base résiliente et performante pour les services de télémétrie et d’orchestration des centres de données.

Qualifications minimales

•    Un baccalauréat avec 7 ans d’expérience connexe ou une maîtrise avec 4 ans d’expérience connexe.
•    Expérience en programmation dans des langages tels que Go et Python, y compris l'utilisation d'outils de développement assistés par intelligence artificielle pour écrire, tester et optimiser le code.
•    Expérience du prototypage rapide des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et de l’ingénierie des flux de travail et des agents d’intelligence artificielle.
•    Expérience du développement, du déploiement et de la gestion de microservices sur des plateformes d’orchestration basées sur Kubernetes.
•    Expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de plans de test robustes pour assurer la qualité, la fiabilité et la couverture des logiciels dans tous les scénarios.

Qualifications recherchées

•    Maîtrise du fonctionnement interne du système Linux, y compris la gestion des processus, des systèmes de fichiers et de la mise en réseau.
•    Compréhension des bases de données distribuées et des systèmes de messagerie, comme PostgreSQL, OpenSearch et Kafka.
•    Expérience des pipelines CI/CD.
 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. 

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $130,400.00 to $181,400.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

The applicable full salary ranges for this position, by specific state, are listed below:

New York City Metro Area:
$167,700.00 - $282,000.00

Non-Metro New York state & Washington state:
$149,100.00 - $250,900.00

* For quota-based sales roles on Cisco’s sales plan, the ranges provided in this posting include base pay and sales target incentive compensation combined.

** Employees in Illinois, whether exempt or non-exempt, will participate in a unique time off program to meet local requirements.
